Marketing and advertising guy here. Advertisers are becoming increasingly reluctant to invest money into traditional advertising - TV especially because of how expensive it is and how segmented the market has become (7 billion channels / networks plus the trending towards commercial free platforms like netflix and IPTV and the fact that people don't watch live TV anymore).

What that leads to is creative agencies being tasked with delivering something that "breaks through the clutter and gets noticed." A few years ago the trend was to have someone whispering in a commercial, then we had commercials where someone was screaming or screatching for some reason, now we have weird commercials (I think the weird stuff started with the puppy-baby-monkey that ran during the superbowl).

You are seeing a lot of these types of commercials because the big brands all engage high-end creative agencies who for the most part aren't particularly creative but more trend-followers who will copy the same trend - usually because some consumer research study was conducted that showed that "consumers reacted more positively to and had better brand recall of ads that had singing sandwiches in them".

tl;dr - consumer research study showed weird commercials got more attention and better brand recall, every ad agency in the world will make same kind of commercials until we're sick to death of them.
